relay.health.live.note: Accessible name and sheet title for the GREEN status dot: the session's process is running on the user's computer, its heartbeat is fresh and the phone's link is up. One short state word; avoid 'Connected' (the phone-link word) and 'Active' (whose negation is Idle).

relay.health.live_detail.note: Sheet body for the green dot. 'Your computer' is the machine running the agent session, not the phone. 'Right away' means delivered to the running session now, not queued for a restart — never promise an instant reply.

relay.health.reconnecting.note: Title of the sheet and accessible name of the YELLOW status dot when the PHONE's own connection is down (the computer may be fine). One short state word, no ellipsis.

relay.health.reconnecting_detail.note: Sheet body for the reconnecting state. It is the PHONE's connection that is down; the session itself may still be running, and the phone keeps trying on its own. 'Sending may fail' is deliberate — never promise that messages wait or are queued.

relay.health.dropped_detail.note: Sheet body for the YELLOW 'Not answering' state when the computer cannot reach the session (degraded). True behaviour to keep: a send fails immediately — it does NOT wait or queue — and the typed text is put back in the message box at the bottom of the screen.

relay.health.quiet_detail.note: Sheet body for the YELLOW 'Not answering' state when the session is reachable but has gone quiet (heartbeat_stale). True behaviour to keep: a send can report a failure yet still be delivered once the session catches up; retrying under the same command id is safe. Do not promise queueing or delivery.

relay.health.ended_detail.note: Sheet body for the GREY 'Ended' state, under the title 'Ended' and above the Resume button — it must add information, not repeat 'ended'. 'Resume' names that button. 'Home folder' is the user's home directory on the computer: the session comes back there, not in its original project folder.

relay.health.ended_send_failed.note: Composer error when sending to an ENDED session failed to reopen it. 'Try again' means sending again. “Ended” (keep the locale's quotation marks) is the status word under the conversation title at the top; tapping it opens the sheet whose button is Resume.

relay.health.ended_placeholder.note: Placeholder inside the empty message field of an ENDED conversation, replacing the usual 'Message…'. Says, before they send, that sending reopens the session in their home folder on the computer. Keep the trailing ellipsis character (…).

relay.health.control_hint.note: Accessibility hint on the header's status control. It opens a sheet explaining the state; never promise an action the sheet does not offer.

relay.health.menu_label.note: Accessible name of the session header's overflow button (the ⋮). Present only when the menu has an item.

relay.health.menu_hint.note: Accessibility hint for the same overflow button.

relay.health.menu_title.note: Title of the overflow menu's sheet. One short noun; not the conversation's name.

relay.health.resume.note: The sheet's one action for an ended session: reopens it in its home folder. Imperative, sentence case, no ellipsis.

relay.health.resuming.note: Shown on the Resume button while the reopen is in flight. Ellipsis is meaningful (work in progress).

relay.health.reopening.note: The acceptance line after Resume, and under the composer while a send to an ended session is reopening it. The daemon's engage takes seconds, so name the wait rather than showing a bare ellipsis.

relay.health.still_reopening.note: Replaces the line above after the reference client's 20 s cap: the reopen is still pending, and the reader should know it has not silently failed.

relay.health.resume_refused_title.note: Title of the sheet's failure notice when Resume did not work.

relay.health.resume_refused.note: The retryable Resume failure. It must agree with the button it sits under, which says "Resume".

relay.health.resume_gone.note: A relay 404 on resume: the conversation is gone. Never invite a retry here — the same words this app's Past sessions screen uses for the same fact.

relay.health.resume_no_route.note: Resume with no connected computer: names the missing prerequisite rather than blaming the session.
